title: Israeli data security startup Cyera raised a $400M Series F led by Blackstone Growth at a $9B valuation, up from $6B after raising $540M in June 2025 (Allie Garfinkle/Fortune)
summary: Allie Garfinkle / Fortune: Israeli data security startup Cyera raised a $400M Series F led by Blackstone Growth at a $9B valuation, up from $6B after raising $540M in June 2025 — Senior Finance Reporter And Author Of Term Sheet — Cyera cofounders Yotam Segev and Tamar Bar-Ilan.CYERA
